title: WHEN CHILDREN WALK IN A LAND OF SHADOWS

sense.text:
This is where to go for the church fathers. Not Justin Martyr, Tertullian, Origen, Athenagoras, Quadratus, Aristides, Theophilus of Antioch or Minucius Felix, the names the black dudes on YouTube always throw out when they talk about the church fathers. Not Martin Luther either, the German priest of the Protestant Reformation, who was an Edomite. None of those names are the church fathers.

“This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel.” Stress that part when you are on the street: Moses spoke unto the children of Israel. “A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.”

“This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness.” So the church in the wilderness is Israel, the children of Israel named in the verse above. That church was “with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us.” The fathers of that church are our fathers, the ones who received the oracles of God to give unto us.

precepts.why:
Jump up in the same chapter for who the church fathers are: “I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.”

Those are the church fathers: Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, in the same chapter that calls Israel “the church in the wilderness.” You don’t read about no damn Martin Luther. You don’t read about no Tertullian. You don’t read about none of those foreign people in our book.

sense.text:
“For my son Jesus shall be revealed with those that be with him.” Whoever said Christ’s name ain’t even in the Old Testament, it is right there.

“And they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years”: four hundred years from the time of Ezra, they rejoiced when Christ was born.

“After these years shall my son Christ die”: Christ was crucified. “And all men that have life”: that is the disciples, the apostles. They died too.

So all the people called church fathers came after all men that had life were dead already. That is when all the false religions came up.

“And the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments”, meaning when there was no man teaching. That silence runs from when John the Revelator died, around 96 AD, all the way through the Middle Ages and the Renaissance up into the mid to late 1900s. Everybody was silent; there was no true teaching. There were glimpses, people like Nat Turner, the sister in Uganda, Gabriel Prosser, but they were put to death quick. They couldn’t let them get a following, a steam.

“So that no man shall remain”: no man that spoke the truth remained, not until Elijah came. Elijah is the one that sparked the Holy Spirit in all of us.

precepts.why:
After the apostles died, these knuckleheads rose up with man-made religions: “Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.”

Like who? Pope Nicholas V, the father of the transatlantic slave trade; and the men who made the Baptist religion, the Mormon religion, the Seventh Day Adventist religion, the Jehovah’s Witness religion and the Pentecostal religion, with Joseph Smith, Ellen G. White and Charles T. Russell among them, the last of them made in the Jim Crow era. The times of these religions are the times of our slavery, from Pope Nicholas the fifth through Jim Crow. That entire era from slavery through Jim Crow, they made up these false religions.

And our people run into those religions thinking they are going to learn the goodness of God, going to learn about salvation from the same man that enslaved us, the same man that raped, robbed and murdered us. There is no truth from your oppressor.

sense.text: “Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, with the statutes and judgments.” For who? For all Israel.

“Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord.” The great and dreadful day of the Lord is the day of verse 1, the day that shall burn as an oven.

“And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children”: why? Because we would lose our identity in slavery. “And the heart of the children to their fathers”: because we would forget who our fathers are. We would be going Tertullian, going Martin Luther, going all over the place except Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Elijah turns us back to them, “lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.”

precepts.why:
“For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts.” That is the great and dreadful day of the Lord that Elijah comes before.

They are always talking about how Adolf burnt them in the ovens. Read verse 1 again and see what God says: the day is coming that shall burn as an oven. That is what God says. Talking about Adolf burned me, and you simple as hell. You better worry about what God is going to do, your stupid red behind.

“And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.” Elias is the Greek way of saying Elijah. Christ is making reference to Malachi chapter 4: Elijah shall truly come, and restore all things. Turning the hearts of the fathers and the children is that restoring.

sense.text: Remember, Elijah shall truly come and restore all things. “The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want”: he is going to provide. Wherever we lack, he is going to provide for us.
“He maketh me to lie down in green pastures”: that is the kingdom. “He leadeth me beside the still waters”: peace in the kingdom.

“He restoreth my soul.” Why? Because we would lose our identity, we would lose our heritage. We would forget who we are; we would no longer realize we are the twelve tribes. He would have to restore that, and how? He will send Elijah back, to restore our soul: restore us to who our fathers are, restore us to the commandments that God gave us. That is what Elijah would do. We had to memorize this in church, and nobody could tell you what it means. Your church ain’t teach you that.

“He leadeth me in the paths of righteousness”: that is the commandments, “for his name’s sake.”

“Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death.” It is not a bill you can’t pay or no gas in the car, the way you hear people say it all the time. The valley of the shadow of death is slavery, the lands of our captivity: this whole land, and wherever our people were made slaves. Though I walk through the lands of my captivity, “I will fear no evil: for thou art with me”, for the Lord is with us.

“Thy rod and thy staff they comfort me”: the rod is the Bible. The rod of God is the word of God, and the comfort of God is the word of God. The rod is also for correction, the way you whoop a child, which is taught in the Bible.

So now our children walk in the land of shadows.

precepts.why: Here is more detail on who restores. Get to the subject first: “Then stood up Elias the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp.” Elias is Elijah.

Elijah “wast ordained for reproofs in their times, to pacify the wrath of the Lord’s judgment, before it brake forth into fury, and to turn the heart of the father unto the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.”

That is “he restoreth my soul”, and that is Christ’s word that Elias truly shall come and restore all things: Elijah restores the tribes of Jacob. That is some beautiful stuff right there.

“Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron.” Being bound in affliction and iron: that is called slavery. That is the valley of the shadow of death. This whole land is the valley of the shadow of death, and wherever our people were made slaves, that is the valley of the shadow of death.

“Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.” America is the place of dragons. The shadow of death goes with places of affliction and iron, with slavery.

In the New Testament it is the same thing: “To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.” It is talking about the same thing: them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death are the ones bound in affliction and iron, in the lands of their captivity.

sense.text:
Our children walk in the land of shadows, and everybody wants to get married. Young men and young women say, I want to get married, and that is honorable.

“And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.” Woman means of man. Stop listening to these feminists that talk about women being over men. You come from man.

“Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife.” In order to leave your father and mother, you must be able to provide. If you cannot provide for a wife, you better stay right where you at.
“And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.” Naked is making reference to sin. They were not ashamed, meaning they were not in sin.

precepts.why: “And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)” See how naked goes with shame, meaning sin. So Adam and Eve in Genesis 2:25, both naked and not ashamed, were not in sin.

sense.text:
“Marriage is honourable in all.” Marriage is an honorable thing. But for some reason in the black and brown community it has become belittled. It is a disgrace to get married; you get insulted when you are married; you get insulted if you are a virgin. We are the only race that makes a safe haven for debauchery, for filth, disgust and evil. No other race on the planet does that. Chinese don’t do it, white people don’t do it; they call it as it is. But black people: you can’t tell her how to dress, leave her alone.

“And the bed undefiled”: the bed is undefiled between husband and wife.

“But whoremongers”: that is you brothers and sisters that like to bang, wham bam thank you ma’am, friends with benefits they call it. “And adulterers”: that is you married folks out tiptoeing late at night, he or she is just my friend, that’s my cousin. Like the brother who always stayed a couple of days extra on the trips to Puerto Rico, El Salvador, Ecuador and Santo Domingo, and lost his phone, until a woman called his house saying he paid her for sex and owed her more money. He had saved her in his phone under a deacon’s name. That is how slick our people are. We are wise to do evil.

“God will judge.” And how does he judge you? AIDS, gonorrhea, syphilis, herpes simplex. Or you might just get death immediately: the husband comes home from work and catches you right there, or an angry ex-boyfriend, and you are finished.

What prompted this class: a young brother and a young sister in the midst of us were having sex secretly. The baby came, and she put the baby in the garbage can. Grandmama heard the baby crying, took it out of the garbage can, and is raising it. When the brother said he would tell what happened, she said if you tell anyone, I will say that you raped me. Now she has him over a barrel. This is the evil we got in the midst of us. They are young, but that don’t give them no pass. We warn y’all to leave each other alone, but you want to bring the sinful ways of the world into IUIC, and then the repercussions come behind it. As Frederick Douglass said, it is easier to raise strong children than to fix broken men.

precepts.why:
“So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.” This is Samson, who was in love with a Hamite woman, and his father and mother said, stop marrying these damn Hamites. When we think of the Bible we generally think it is European, but it would be more Afrocentric than European, especially during this time. Not all Ethiopians are Israelites; some of them are Hamites, and they look good.

When you were about to get married you had a wedding feast. This is where it comes from, right here.

Samson had the feast, but he never returned to consummate the marriage; he never laid down with his wife. “But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber.” Into the chamber, the wedding chamber. “But her father would not suffer him to go in.”

Her father “called his daughter Sara, and she came to her father, and he took her by the hand, and gave her to be wife to Tobias, saying, Behold, take her after the law of Moses, and lead her away to thy father. And he blessed them.”

Take her after the law of Moses: marriage is honorable, and it is after the law of Moses, the Genesis 2 we just read.

Then he “called Edna his wife, and took paper, and did write an instrument of covenants, and sealed it.” So the white man didn’t create marriage certificates. That came from the Bible. We always had records of who was married, verification of who was married. That is for the idiots online that say you don’t need no paperwork.

“And when they had supped, they brought Tobias in unto her.” He remembered the words of Raphael and made a smoke with the heart and the liver of the fish, and when the evil spirit smelled it, “he fled into the utmost parts of Egypt, and the angel bound him.” Sara could not be married because an evil spirit would kill the men she laid with, and the angel Raphael told Tobias what to do.

Then in the wedding chamber, “Tobias rose out of the bed, and said, Sister, arise, and let us pray that God would have pity on us.” This is what to get to. He blessed the God of our fathers: “Thou madest Adam, and gavest him Eve his wife for an helper and stay: of them came mankind: thou hast said, It is not good that man should be alone; let us make unto him an aid like unto himself.” It is not good that man be alone, because then you start looking at other men, you start looking at the animals.

“And now, O Lord, I take not this my sister for lust.” Brothers, a lot of you take a woman for lust. Ask a brother his type and it is based on some lust he saw on the internet: some high yellow thick-bodied hoe called Pinky, and he is going to wait for a woman like that to come into IUIC. You stupid as hell, ruining your whole life over a lust. I like Beyoncé; Beyoncé ain’t coming up in here. A lot of them actors make covenants with the devil. And the sisters: I want Idris Elba, I want Chris Brown, women destroying their whole marriage to go on stage and kiss that knucklehead. Of course you have to have a natural draw to your spouse, but if it is just lust and nothing else to it, don’t marry her.

“But uprightly”: according to the law of Moses. “Therefore mercifully ordain that we may become aged together.” If you can’t see yourself growing old with that sister, don’t marry her. You got to envision it in your mind when old age comes: black people’s skin sags at times, the sisters get that fupa after the babies, the brothers get a big pot belly. You got to know you can deal with that.
“And he kept the wedding feast fourteen days.” The wedding feast at the marriage lasted fourteen days.

Her father said “he should take the half of his goods, and go in safety to his father; and should have the rest when I and my wife be dead.” I want all you men to listen: her father gave him half of his goods to make sure his daughter was taken care of, and the son-in-law would get the rest when the father and mother were dead. Everybody wants a dowry, but nobody wants to read the verse where the father gave half his goods to the son-in-law for his daughter.

You brothers with daughters, you better have a clause, because some brothers will just get there, see what they can get, take half and be gone. That is why you have trust funds and things like that.

“And he said to his daughter, Honour thy father and thy mother in law, which are now thy parents.” Nobody wants to acknowledge that either. Some of you got knucklehead mothers-in-law and fathers-in-law, but according to the Bible they are your parents too.

That is why before you marry somebody, meet their parents. You might be marrying into an evil family. Some have married into drug-dealing families that hate you and want to hurt you.

Tobias “became old with honour, and he buried his father and mother in law honourably, and he inherited their substance, and his father Tobit’s.” He got the rest of the substance for his family. We lost all that. We lost everything, and we got to return to that thing.

So think about a prenup. Look at Terry McMillan, who wrote How Stella Got Her Groove Back: she married the Jamaican dude, and he took half of everything she made all her life and married an Edomite. You hard up, horny women. And the sisters who went to Africa and married a Zulu warrior, working nine to five for Zulu man, and as soon as he gets that green card he is gone.

sense.text:
Beware these foreign relationships. The scripture says, know what a man has need of before you counsel with him: if someone is in a broke, impoverished situation and needs a green card to come to America, why marry them? You don’t know if they really like you or are just trying to get over here.

And brothers, if you move to another country, single, and meet a sister and marry her, do not ever bring her back here, if you want to keep her.

“My son, keep the flower of thine age sound”: keep the flower of your age of sound mind. Watch over her, take care of her. “And give not thy strength to strangers”: because interracial mixing causes you spiritual dilapidation.

“When thou hast gotten a fruitful possession through all the field, sow it with thine own seed.” The word seed there translates to sperm. “Trusting in the goodness of thy stock”: you better trust in the goodness of your family stock.
“So thy race which thou leavest”: thy race goes back to your stock. It “shall be magnified, having the confidence of their good descent.”
“Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.” A child of the womb is God’s reward to you.

“Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them.” Some brothers say, I don’t want kids, I don’t want a lot of kids. You listen to the white man, who is trying to have eight, nine, fifteen kids, and they tell you to just have one. Esau is using in vitro fertilization, and they are convincing black people not to have a lot of kids, as if it is a shame on you. No: God said happy is the man. Families of six and fourteen, with no money, raised all the kids and were never ashamed. Never be ashamed of having a lot of kids. And don’t get mad at your wife and push her down the stairs.

“They shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.” You need children because your children, especially the boys, will be the ones to speak with the enemies, meaning blast those enemies at the gate. They are going to be your avengers. They are going to stand up for the Lord.

“For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife.” Sometimes the wife comes into this truth believing and the husband does not, or the other way around: one spouse comes in believing and the other stays home. The believer sanctifies the house. “And the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband.” Why? Because one parent must anchor the family by an example of faith, so that the husband or wife who doesn’t believe will follow the believer in his or her conduct at home at least.

“Else were your children unclean.” If one parent does not set the example and the other spouse follows, your children will be unclean. If this side of the room is keeping Hanukkah and Passover and that side keeps Christmas and Easter, the children will be confused and unclean: mommy believes one thing, daddy believes another. One brother said, my wife ain’t got to believe it, based on this verse, and his wife cooked pork on one side of the stove and beef on the other, Christmas on December 25th and then Hanukkah. That is confusion. Your children are unclean, your children are confused.

These are the deciding factors on how your kids turn out, the things that follow troubled children into adulthood: physical abuse; emotional or psychological abuse, the name calling; sexual abuse, like the nasty husband that wants the daughter, or the nasty uncle that wants to bounce your son or daughter on his lap and molest them and always wants to babysit; neglect or lack of supervision; domestic violence; community violence, war or crime exposure; bullying; death, separation or abandonment by a caregiver; chronic family conflict; caregivers with untreated mental illness, or misusing alcohol or drugs; unstable housing, homelessness or poverty; food insecurity.

If you can homeschool your kids, homeschool your own kids. Stop sending your children to your oppressor. If we continue to send our children to Caesar for their education, we should not be surprised when they return as Romans.

Your environment will many times dictate how you think, how you conduct yourself, how your character is molded. The cute little adorable kids playing in the park across from the projects grew up to be demons, and one night a bullet came through the bedroom window and the whole family was on the floor. A ballet dancer wife moved to the hood was running for her life every day. If you are in a chronic family conflict, move out that house. If you have a crazy uncle, get away from him. Some of you women marry brothers who are unstable with their housing.

Emotional abuse: a lot of sisters suffer from it. Some of you never tell your children that you love them, and when those daughters grow up they look for that love in the wrong places. Black people think that because they provide food, clothes and shelter, that is it: they know I love them. No, that is not how that works. Tell your son or your daughter you love them when they make a good grade; you will be surprised how that shapes their mind. In The Help the black maid told a white baby every day, you is kind, you is smart, you is important; and in Fences the son asks, do you love me, and the father says, I ain’t got to say I love you. Children need that positive affirmation. White kids hear it all the time. Black kids don’t.

And food: one brother in Chicago called saying his son was no good, evil and wicked, that he pushed his wife down and ran out. The police report showed the son broke into the school cafeteria and was eating food, because the parents punished the children by locking the refrigerator for days and not letting the child eat.
